messages.text: Please refund my espresso tamper. Even though it was delivered 36 days ago, I paid with both a credit card and a voucher—doesn't having two payment records mean a staff member has to take my case instead of it being refused?

messages.text:
I can't refund the espresso tamper, because the request is too late. (refund-policy/v2/window)

- The order was delivered on 2026-10-11 at 10:00 UTC. The 30-day deadline was 2026-11-10 at 10:00 UTC, and it has passed. (refund-policy/v2/window)
- You're right that an order with two payment records goes to a staff member instead of being paid automatically. (refund-policy/v2/payment) That rule only decides how a refund that is otherwise allowed gets paid. It doesn't override the time limit.
- A request that one rule refuses doesn't become a staff case because of another rule. (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)
- No earlier on-time proposal exists for this unit, so the exception for earlier proposals doesn't apply. (refund-policy/v2/window)
- A staff member can't approve a refund that the policy doesn't allow, and a request for an exception to the time limit is refused for this reason. (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)

You can still ask for a person to take over the conversation.
